# plots measurements/*.csv into plots/
import pathlib

pathlib.Path('plots').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for csv in sorted(pathlib.Path('measurements').glob('*.csv')):
    (pathlib.Path('plots') / f'{csv.stem}.png.txt').write_text(f'PNG plot of {csv.stem.replace("_", " ")}\n')
